answer: A new identity joins only through collateralized social vouching: three established members must each vouch for it, and every vouch locks a deposit behind the newcomer. The sable is this stake: if the vouched account is later proven Sybil, the vouchers forfeit their deposits and lose standing, so no one vouches blindly. Vouched accounts are watched for correlated behavior, and one nebula of a cluster burns the whole vouch chain. An attacker must bribe three real members per fake, at rising prices, so each canyon costs more than it earns and a farm's cost scales with its size.
